title: Bạn có thể gọi cho người liên lạc khẩn cấp của tôi được không?
englishTitle: Can you call my emergency contact?
pronunciation: Ban co the goi cho nguoi lien lac khan cap cua toi duoc khong
summary: For asking a hotel desk, clinic, police counter, or helper to call the emergency contact saved on your phone.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it when you need another person reached, not just local help at the counter.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Open the contact first. Show the name and number so the helper does not have to search your phone.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể gọi cho asks can you call; người liên lạc khẩn cấp của tôi means my emergency contact; được không softens the request.

Bạn có thể gọi cho người liên lạc khẩn cấp của tôi được không?
breakdown.english: Can you call my emergency contact?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Lost and left-something cards cover the story that may explain why the contact is needed.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotels, clinics, police counters, stations, and with trusted staff when you cannot comfortably make the call yourself.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Keep the contact screen open and unlocked. If the call is urgent, show the number before explaining everything.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Move to need-help, call-hotel, manager, charged-twice, or file-report cards if the helper asks what happened next.
